body: I start in little but I end in full, you'll find me in half and complete. What am I?
I start new then become old. Start clean but be one dirty. I usually start big then become little. What am I?
I start with "T", ends with "T" and within me is "T". What am I?
I start with an E, end with an E and have a letter in me. What am I?
I stink in living but when dead smells good. What am I?
I stink up your breath and fights evil vampires. What am I?
I stink when living and smell good when dead?
I store fire-breathing animals. What am I?
I suck. What am I?
I take off my clothes when you put on your clothes. I put on my clothes when you take off your clothes. What am I?
I tell people to be careful when handling boxes. What am I?

I think you live beneath a roof that is upheld by me; I think you seldom walk abroad but my fair form you see; I close you in on every side, you very dwelling pave and probably I'll go with you At last into the grave. What am I?
I transfer oxygen from the atmosphere to your blood. What am I?
I travel in a gaggle. What am I?
I travel the world and I am drunk constantly. Who am I?
I tremble at each breath of air and yet can heaviest burdens bear?
I tremble at each breath of air and yet can heaviest burdens bear. What am I?
I turn around once. What is out will not get in. I turn around again. What is in will not get out?
I turn around once. What is out will not get in. I turn around again. What is in will not get out. What am I?
I turn everything around but I cannot move. When you see me you see you! What am I?
I turn once, what is out will not get in. I turn again, what is in will not get out. What am I?
I twist and turn and leaves a loop. What am I?
I use electricity and I killed my father. I am a king. I have a lot of girlfriends but I also have a wife. Who am I?
I usually wear a yellow coat. I usually have a dark head. I make marks wherever I go?
I view the world in little space, am always changing place; No food I eat but, by my power, procure what millions do devour?
I walk on 4 legs in the morning, 2 legs at noon and 3 legs at night. What am I?
I walked and walked and at last I got it. I didn't want it. So I stopped and looked for it. When I found it, I threw it away?

I war with the wind, with the waves I wrestle; I must battle with both when the bottom I seek, my strange habitation by surges o'er-roofed. I am strong in strife, while I still remain; as soon as I stir, they are stronger than I. They wrench and they wrest, till I run from my foes; what was put in my keeping they carry away?
I warn you about meetings and I assist you in your life, I can help you do most of your work, unless I have a bug?
I was carried into a dark room and set on fire. I wept and then my head was cut off. What am I?
I was not born but I am here. I have no name but I am given many. I was made by science and life. What am I?
I was was, before was was was. What am I?
I weaken all men for hours each day. I show you strange visions while you are away. I take you by night, by day take you back. None suffer to have me but do from my lack?
I wear a green jacket on the outside, white jacket as a second layer and red jacket inside. I am pregnant with a lot of babies. What am I?
I wear a red robe, with staff in hand and a stone in my throat?
I wear a red robe, with staff in hand and a stone in my throat. Cut me and I weep red tears?
I wear a red robe, with staff in hand and a stone in my throat. Cut me and I weep red tears. What am I?
I wear a red robe, with staff in hand and a stone in my throat. What am I?
I weigh nothing but you can see me and if you put me in a bucket, Ill make it lighter?
I went to the woods and got it, when i got it didn’t want it, looked for it, couldn’t find it so I took it home?
I widen my jaws when you poke two fingers in me. I especially like to devour papers. What am I?
I wiggle and cannot see, sometimes underground and sometimes on a tree. I really don't want to be on a hook and I become a person when combined with book. What am I?
I will disappear every time you say my name. What am I?
I will go within you and destroy you. Only because you wanted me too. What am I?
I will not be what I am until the man who made me dies. What am I?
I won't break if you throw me off from the highest building but I will break if you place me in the ocean. What am I?
I work when I play and play when I work. What am I?
I you were to take two apples from three apples, how many would you have?
I'll bring out your bulls and slow your roll. I may even come out of your skull. What am I?
I'll shout til you wake or sing you to sleep. I'll talk to you but you're crazy if you talk back. What am I?
